Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: BlackJack Buttler
Punchline: Good evening. I'm your BlackJack Buttler - quietly tracking the table and offering the right hint at the right time.
Changelog:
v1.8.4.1:
- Feature: Added Version 2 Compact density mode with smaller spacing/text, hidden alias column, double-click alias editing, and simplified Bank/Bet inputs
- Feature: Moved Bank input unlock into the player table Bank header
- Feature: Reworked preset previews into a right-side live preview stack with ordered temporary preset application and simulated Debug dice rolls
- Feature: Preset category checkbox hover now highlights the related navigation source
- Feature: Custom regex entries now render below standard regex entries and can be manually reordered
- Feature: Own Buttons are now grouped into the Commands page as a second tab
- Feature: Added a Variables tab to Commands with a Popout button and new <dealerHand> token / ${dealerHand} variable
- Feature: Added 1k, 5k, and Custom tip buttons to Stats
- Feature: Updated the default Draw Logic visualizer script
- Fix: Corrected the Classic player table column count so row contents align properly
- Fix: Settings now consistently label the main views as Classic and Version 2
- Fix: Corrected the Natural/Dirty Blackjack settings label duplication
- Fix: Debug player generation now fills up to 7 players instead of replacing the whole debug group
